title: No viewer request is answered 500, and no subtitle is refused, across a Postgres switchover
description: Serves "Nothing breaks the viewers' evening."; "Failures are invisible.". docs/status.md calls Postgres failover done and says requests are held instead of answering 500, but findings say otherwise: a subtitle is refused for 30 s after a read that hit the outage, and a film started from the snapshot ignores the viewer's languages (product owner triage, 2026-11-19).
acceptanceCriteria: During a real Postgres switchover (real processes), no viewer request of a playing film or a starting one is answered 500; each waits or is served as docs/running.md states
A subtitle read that hit the outage is served once Postgres answers, not refused for 30 s
A film started from the snapshot while Postgres is away plays with the viewer's audio and subtitle languages
The cases of BL-062, BL-064, BL-068 and BL-168 each have a check
docs/status.md and docs/running.md say what holds across a switchover, with the check for each

Through a switchover, a copied job keeps invariant 57's lead: with a viewer stopped early, it stores no segment, and reads no film, past the lead and one segment beyond the furthest segment asked for.
